rationale: Calculated using the equal-area criterion formulas provided in the task instructions. 1) delta0 = asin(Pm/prefault_pmax). 2) delta_max = pi - asin(Pm/postfault_pmax). 3) delta_critical from cos(delta_cr) = (Pm*(delta_max - delta0) + postfault_pmax*cos(delta_max)) / postfault_pmax. 4) critical_clearing_time from t_cr = sqrt(4*H*(delta_cr - delta0) / (2*pi*f0*Pm)). Angles converted to degrees, time is in seconds.
